queries.name: counts_by_moratorium
queries.sql: SELECT moratorium_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM SITEWHY.county_sources GROUP BY moratorium_id ORDER BY moratorium_id

queries.name: all_sources
queries.sql: SELECT moratorium_id, title FROM SITEWHY.county_sources ORDER BY moratorium_id

rows.title: Washington County, MD draft moratorium ordinance (PDF)

queries.name: orphan_sources
queries.sql: SELECT c.moratorium_id, c.title FROM SITEWHY.county_sources c LEFT JOIN SITEWHY.moratoria m ON c.moratorium_id = m.moratorium_id WHERE m.moratorium_id IS NULL
